code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated RDW, and mild protein deficiency. There is also mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine), hyperchloremia, monocytosis, and basophilia. These findings may suggest a chronic or acute systemic process such as infection, inflammation, bone marrow suppression, or renal dysfunction. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
